cli.intro: panduck — document conversion orchestrator for notedown-ir::DocumentGraph
cli.cmd.convert: Convert one input document to a target format
cli.cmd.plan: Probe input and plan a conversion pipeline without writing output
cli.cmd.inspect: Inspect input format and container structure
cli.cmd.check: Validate source or generated output against Panduck contracts
cli.cmd.formats: List format capabilities from the shared registry
cli.cmd.doctor: Check CLI install, native bindings, and environment
cli.opt.to: Target format ID (e.g. epub, docx, markdown, notedown)
cli.opt.from: Source format ID when detection should be skipped
cli.opt.output: Output file path, or - for stdout
cli.opt.asset-policy: Asset handling: preserve, copy, embed, or drop
cli.opt.link-policy: Link handling: preserve, rewrite, or drop
cli.opt.loss: Loss policy: allow, warn, or deny
cli.opt.strict: Reject unknown coverage in addition to loss
cli.opt.allow-partial: Allow publishing partial source reads when the writer accepts them
cli.opt.diagnostics: Diagnostics channel: silent, human, or json
cli.opt.report: Write JSON report to a file, or - for stdout
cli.opt.dry-run: Alias for plan-style validation on convert
cli.opt.stage: Inspect depth: probe, index, decode, or validate
cli.opt.operation: Filter formats by read or write operation
cli.err.same_path: Input and output paths must not be the same: {path}
cli.err.missing_to_stdout: Writing to stdout requires an explicit --to format
cli.err.stdin_batch: Standard input cannot be used with --batch
cli.err.unsupported_target: Target format {format} is not ready for {operation}
cli.err.unsupported_source: Source format {format} is not ready for read
cli.err.output_exists: Output already exists; pass --overwrite to replace it
